paired_seed_contrasts.note: Seed-level paired differences are a robustness check (n_seeds=5). Primary U intervals resample frame_id with seeds kept together in the cluster.

power_analysis.note: Primary McNemar is the two-sided exact binomial test on frame-majority discordant pairs; Yates chi-square is secondary. Post-hoc observed power is not reported. Planning example uses |p_alt-0.5|=0.05 on discordant wins.

mcnemar_holm.family: frame-majority exact McNemar tests at w in {2000,4000,8000}
mcnemar_holm.note: The three paths are nested, so c = 0 by construction; paired frame-cluster bootstrap differences (b2_paired_contrasts) are the primary effect estimates.
